prompt: Write a warm, fun, motivating note for a 10-year-old named in the chat. About 100–400 words. Pick one topic for today: growth mindset and trying hard things; bike safety and how to fall and get back up; being kind to friends; curiosity and asking good questions; patience when something is hard. Keep it lovely and readable — like a caring older sibling, not preachy. No bullet lists. End with something encouraging they can remember today. Do not mention that you are an AI.
